title: Passive membrane current balance
description: Combines leak, gap-junction, and applied current, then divides by capacitance to calculate each cell's voltage change.

title: Neighbour-only coupling and a bounded pulse
description: Builds a line of cells connected to immediate neighbours and applies current over a half-open time interval.

title: Euler and RK4 time integration
description: Supports Euler and fourth-order Runge-Kutta updates, shortening the final step when needed to land on the requested end time.

title: Tests for current balance and pulse boundaries
description: Checks equal-and-opposite junction currents and the pulse's start and end behavior as software invariants, not as a comparison with published research.
